metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2023 · Twinkling Watermelon
metas.description: "Sparkling Watermelon" will tell the story of a boy living a double life between a model student and a band member who gets to time slip and meets his 18-year-old father. The two will build friendships there.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2022 · Campus Diaries
metas.description: Campus Diaries is a coming-of-age drama of six students at Excel University.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2022 · Shoresy
metas.description: The foul-mouthed, chirp-serving, mother-loving, fan favorite character Shoresy joins a senior AAA hockey team in Sudbury to never lose again.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2022 · The Bear
metas.description: A young chef from the fine dining world returns to Chicago to run his family's sandwich shop.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2023 · Lucky Guy
metas.description: The series dives into the strange life of Lucky, a college student who appears to have it all since birth, but now his luck has become a bane as he is faced with some of the most difficult situations of his life.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · Common Side Effects
metas.description: Two former classmates uncover a sinister conspiracy to destroy a mushroom that can cure all the world's diseases.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · Lovely Runner
metas.description: Right after top star Ryoo Seon-jae ends his life, his top fan Im Sol somehow time-travels back to when they were in high school and tries to protect him. A fantasy romance unfolds where people who missed each other in time finally...

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2022 · This Is Going to Hurt
metas.description: Set on Labour Ward with all its hilarity and heart-lifting highs but also its gut-wrenching lows, the show delivers a brutally honest depiction of life as a junior doctor on the wards, and the toll the job can take back home.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2022 · Somebody Somewhere
metas.description: Sam is a true Kansan on the surface, but, beneath it all, struggles to fit the hometown mold. Grappling with loss and acceptance, she discovers herself and a community of outsiders who don't fit in but don't give up.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity
metas.description: An elite girls' school resides next to a boys' school for delinquents. One day, two students from each school, Kaoruko and Rintaro, meet and develop a connection.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2023 · Shrinking
metas.description: A grieving therapist starts to tell his clients exactly what he thinks. Ignoring his training and ethics, he finds himself making huge changes to people's lives - including his own.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · Bad Sisters
metas.description: The Garvey sisters are bound together by their parents' deaths and a promise to always protect one another.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Queen of Tears
metas.description: A miraculous love story of a married couple overcoming a dizzying crisis.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Scrubs
metas.description: JD and Turk scrub in together after a long break. Medicine and interns have evolved, but their friendship remains strong. New and familiar faces at Sacred Heart bring laughs, emotion, and unexpected moments.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · The Gentlemen
metas.description: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to a huge weed empire, and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2022 · Business Proposal
metas.description: In disguise as her friend, Ha-ri shows up to a blind date to scare him away. But plans go awry when he turns out to be her CEO - and makes a proposal.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Ludwig
metas.description: While seeking to unravel the mystery of his twin brother's disappearance, reclusive puzzle-designer John 'Ludwig' Taylor takes on his twin brother James's identity as DCI on Cambridge's major crimes squad.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2022 · Colin from Accounts
metas.description: A microbrewery owner and a student doctor are brought together by a car accident that injures a stray dog they agree to adopt, forcing them to navigate each other's vulnerabilities.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2022 · Tomorrow
metas.description: Made half-human and half-spirit by accident, a young man is employed by a company of grim reapers in the underworld to carry out special missions.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Mr. Plankton
metas.description: A man with little chance for happiness and his ex, the unhappiest bride-to-be, are forced to accompany one another on the final journey of his life.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · Beef
metas.description: A minor conflict spirals into a consuming feud between two individuals, exposing pride, resentment, and hidden pain.
